mapper.select: SELECT region_id AS regionId, weather_date AS weatherDate, min_temp AS minTemp, max_temp AS maxTemp, rain_percent AS rainPercent, wind_speed AS windSpeed, cloud_percent AS cloudPercent, weather_text AS weatherText, icon_code AS iconCode, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_forecast_cache WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND weather_date = CURDATE() LIMIT 1

SELECT region_id AS regionId, weather_date AS weatherDate, min_temp AS minTemp, max_temp AS maxTemp, rain_percent AS rainPercent, wind_speed AS windSpeed, cloud_percent AS cloudPercent, weather_text AS weatherText, icon_code AS iconCode, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_forecast_cache WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND weather_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY weather_date ASC LIMIT 7
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_forecast_cache ( region_id, weather_date, min_temp, max_temp, rain_percent, wind_speed, cloud_percent, weather_text, icon_code, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{weatherDate}, #{minTemp}, #{maxTemp}, #{rainPercent}, #{windSpeed}, #{cloudPercent}, #{weatherText}, #{iconCode}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE min_temp = VALUES(min_temp), max_temp = VALUES(max_temp), rain_percent = VALUES(rain_percent), wind_speed = VALUES(wind_speed), cloud_percent = VALUES(cloud_percent), weather_text = VALUES(weather_text), icon_code = VALUES(icon_code), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weather_forecast_cache WHERE DATE(updated_at) = CURDATE()
